usedFor: SuperPhone holds text contacts and messages, and Freshsales Classic updates a deal through “Update Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “Contact Tags Changed” in SuperPhone, then “Update Deal” in Freshsales Classic
bestTemplate.why: A tag change can mark a deal's next step, and the action edits its amount, stage or close date.

watchOut: “Contact Updated” in SuperPhone fires on every contact edit, so one contact can update the deal repeatedly.
